ALGER — Le Conseil africain de l’Intelli: ALGIERS — The African Council for Artificial Intelligence officially launched its work during a meeting chaired by the Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, Sidali Zerrougui. The Council adopts a roadmap and an action plan for the next two years, with the creation of six specialized committees.
Lancement des travaux du Conseil africai: Launch of the work of the African AI Council
Le Conseil africain de l’Intelligence Ar: The African Council for Artificial Intelligence (CAIA) held its second meeting, marking the effective start of its activities. The Minister of Posts and Telecommunications, Sidali Zerrougui, actively participated. During this meeting, the participants adopted a roadmap as well as a work plan covering the next two years.
Six comités spécialisés ont été mis en p: Six specialized committees have been set up to implement the axes of the African strategy in terms of artificial intelligence. These structures will have the mission of supervising the implementation of priority initiatives identified within the framework of this continental strategy.
La réunion s’inscrit dans le cadre des p: The meeting is part of the preparations for the World Summits on the Information Society planned for 2026, as well as work related to the governance of artificial intelligence on an African scale.
Une plainte des habitants d’Ammaria sur: A complaint from Ammaria residents about the degradation of Internet service
Parallèlement, des habitants de la commu: At the same time, residents of the commune of Ammaria, in the wilaya of Blida, sent a public complaint to Algérie Télécom concerning the persistent degradation of their Internet service. Residents of the Ben Slimane El Miloud district denounce frequent interruptions and a significant drop in flow.
Ils attribuent ces dysfonctionnements à: They attribute these malfunctions to the advanced age of the copper cables and wires serving the neighborhood. These infrastructures, deemed incapable of supporting current flows, are subject to accelerated wear and environmental impacts. Residents are calling for urgent intervention to replace this equipment with fiber optic infrastructure (FTTH).
Ils sollicitent également une inspection: They also request an immediate technical inspection of existing cables and the inclusion of their neighborhood in network modernization projects.
